what: An orbital groove engine: four rings circle a sun at small ratios (1:1 5:4 3:2 7:4), and the same ratios are pure intervals above it, so every polyrhythm is a chord. The voice is a planet on an ellipse: Kepler orbit synthesis with moons, slingshot, precession and dust. Just intonation with gravity, harmonic keys, trigger logic between the rings, macros, an orbit pad, a filter map, delay and a nebula. 10 systems.
author: joakimskurk
